svg.title: Stance interface kit
svg.text: The kit that made it shippable
A small system, on purpose: 9 colours, 6 type sizes, 14 components. Everything else is a combination.
Each with default / hover / focus / disabled / error
The states nobody asks for, drawn anyway
Two developers, ten weeks, one designer. A system you cannot maintain is a system that drifts by month three.
Handed over as a Figma library plus a one-page README in the repo — the part people actually read.
